title: Atomic KPI verifier grant wakes eligible evidence wait
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-p15-10c.test.ts#KVA grant wake for settled KPI evidence queue
description: HIGH-risk scheduler/KPI endpoint repair against BASE e0885f7de03e2a961680a3b72e458fb398bb4a62. Two defects fixed. (1) WAITING_EVIDENCE/VERIFIED_KPI_EVIDENCE deadlock: owner-scoped canonical KPI grant now wakes a settled quiet queue atomically in the same store.immediate as the grant (endpoint composition); scheduler.notifyKpiVerifierGrant re-proves queue state, full authority binding, no active lease, KVA identity+schema+digest+effective state, and writes a receipt-bound (kpi-verifier-grant:<authorization_id>) idempotent wake source + pending_generation bump. Healthy/quarantined/blocked/active/non-KPI waits and malformed/forged/revoked/expired/foreign grants never wake; grant never mints progress — the KVR still comes only from the pass verifier. (2) Precision defect exposed by the new real end-to-end test: the pass's OWN canonical verifier write (kpiVerification.advance -> recordProgress) bumps the objective's monotonic row.version, which the stale-binding pins compared verbatim — mid-pass authority_gate then self-invalidated the lease as DRIVER_AUTHORITY_LOST. The pins in claimable/requireCurrent/requireRebind/currentLease now bind authority identity only (policy_version, terms_digest_binding, terms_current = live objective_digest re-proof, owner, business, effective) — terms_version/protected-terms drift still fails closed via terms_current; runtime progress/spend/evidence writes no longer count as drift. No lease lifecycle, heartbeat, retry, or sign-off semantics changed; objective_version fields remain written for diagnostics. Coverage: focused KVA rearm/idempotency/no-op/owner + new negatives (malformed/unknown id, revoked, expired, BLOCKED_AUTHORITY, atomic grant+wake rollback, distinct-grant no double generation) and a REAL end-to-end A2 test: no KVA -> quiet wait -> atomic owner grant -> next driver tick -> real runObjectivePass mints KVR -> TARGET_MET_CANDIDATE with owner sign-off still required, no manual ceo-cycle. No merge.
